## Why
RUN16 left the post-birth gas reconstruction defect and feedback transfer unresolved. This bounded continuation isolates the first outgoing-to-next-incoming birth panel using the original finite M2 packet and native HHeD owners.

## Changes
- Add two 265-state native controls, lossless dense coefficients, complete RHS traces and source/input identities.
- Implement analytic dense derivatives, full native/photo forcing residual decomposition, and a singular-safe comparison propagator.
- Certify 24 stored gas polynomial pieces and 5,796 depth polynomials with exact rational Bernstein bounds.
- Preserve 12 actual focused test results, one independent review, figures and exact reproduction commands.

## Results and scope
PCHIP minus native endpoint HI is -3.800718802625755 ppm; temperature is +0.12465231681380828 K. Initial path difference and the integrated P defect dominate the hydrogen contrast. This certifies stored-polynomial admissibility, not true-IVP or spectral continuum error. Prefix uncertainty, tube-wide residual/Jacobian bounds and representation jumps remain explicit.

Two new bounded native IVPs plus point diagnostics used 1,378 RHS calls. No RUN13 M2 or RUN16 prefix rerun. Changes are add-only under run17; the original DAG and physical owners remain intact. Delivery receipts and independently read-back Drive/Dropbox archives will be added after the immutable science snapshot.

- Build a DOP853 degree-seven exact/interval adapter with num-rational 0.4.2 and num-bigint 0.4.6; include Cargo.lock, official dependency archives, source, binary and raw TSV/JSONL evidence.
- Find 431 nonzero depth-coordinate jumps at three interfaces, zero gas-value jumps, and define an exactly continuous, nonnegative depth reconstruction.
- Establish the repair-only positive-channel response factor beta = 9/288230376151711735. It is not a true-IVP or spectral continuum bound.
- Record the actual current VigilODE source readback and preserve the original 45/26-node DAG obligations.

Validation: 4 actual Rust tests passed; 5,911 exact cases match an independent Python reference; 5,911 right-endpoint values and 5,911 derivatives are included by the imported interval arithmetic. No native RHS, IVP, quadrature or historical m2 reruns in RUN18. One scoped independent review is preserved.

Parent: RUN17 delivery 0e23addf4fefa69287d4626622bf97505677ea43 (stacked on #207).
